photos.desc: Resident adult male yellow or mangrove warbler (Bryant's warbler) ( Setophaga petechial bryanti ) in mangroves near Quepos, Costa Rica.
The Golden Warbler is a subspecies group of Dendroica petechia. They reside in the mangrove swamps of the West Indies. This photo was taken at Mary's Point Pond on St. John, US Virgin Islands.
